Using the Tools

Start with connectivity, a subscription, and a client. Express the need in Chinese, let the model select and combine suitable Skills, connect tools, and complete an actual task, then improve the environment through feedback from use.

Resources & Advice

The local environment supports people and models working together; Prometheus2Heraclitus preserves source others can build on; the website brings works into reading and conversation.

Continue the conversation

Improve reusable Skills and tools and submit a pull request, or open an Issue to discuss a problem. For philosophy, develop your own work from your experience and ideas; corrections, objections, and improvements to this collection are also welcome through Issues and pull requests. Thoughts can also be shared in the page comments.
